title: Some Unique Places
lesson: To understand ‘Some Unique Places’, begin with the situation presented in the chapter and identify what is happening. Focus on distinctive Indian landscapes and wildlife and habitats, then look for evidence for place-based livelihoods. Finally, explain what you learned and how the idea can guide a decision or observation outside the chapter.
